name: idle-wear
description: Plan §4’s absolute rule, as a pinned world: wear is per operation and never per second. Opens with klapaucius, places a Washer (the surviving converter — item 145 deleted the Chip Kitchen the original bought), and then never touches it again for ten thousand ticks. It completes no operations, so it must end at full condition — a machine that aged on the clock shows up here as a changed hash, and factory.test.ts reads this fixture back and says so in words. Re-recorded 2026-08-27; see scripts/record-idle-wear.ts.
